verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at docs.bentolabs.ai (HTTP 200). The docs also say a paste-in prompt installs Bento's Agent Skills into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode or Windsurf, hands the agent the full integration playbook, and loads the docs over MCP. Markdown versions of the doc pages (.md) are also served for agent consumption. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming llms.txt or the skill-driven docs end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Paste this into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, or Windsurf. It installs Bento’s Agent Skills and hands the agent the full integration playbook
Each tool installs the skill the same way, then loads the docs over MCP.
